purpose: Generated resolved connection description; edit source declarations or compiled resources, then refresh.

coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 over Avenue L0 — Diagonal 90° — Parallel.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 over Avenue L0 — Diagonal 90° — Parallel
piece.description: Place one dd rhw / avenue crossing for the close parallel diagonal diamond. Use the complete connection cards and assembly grid; heights are fixed.

engineering.path_ownership: Every full native and ramp fragment in each owned city cell
engineering.reuse_limit: Outside-deck access PATHs change all four ordinary highway continuation cells; no whole existing native half is substituted

provenance.geometry: Approved parallel inward-upper layout with exact source coordinates, finite right turns, and fixed levels.
provenance.construction: Disjoint whole-cell traffic owners; separate physical models may overhang neighbouring cells.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
